events.what: Zeng claims a full affirmative proof that the first eigenvalue on any embedded minimal hypersurface of S^{n+1} is n
events.credibility_reason: F5: landmark problem, over a year with no citations, commentary or acceptance; two later preprints bounding exactly this eigenvalue (2603.20890, Mar 2026; 2606.10962, Jun 2026) still call the conjecture open and do not cite the claim; a full proof via a minimizing sequence and the variational principle is a method this long-open problem is not expected to yield to so simply. Counterweight: the author has prior work in the area, so this is a judgement call, but same-topic silence is as close to a knock-down as silence gets.

events.what: Zhao improves the Choi-Wang lower bound on the first eigenvalue of embedded minimal hypersurfaces in the unit sphere
Preprint giving an improved partial lower bound on the same eigenvalue

judgement.doubts: Zeng's claim is set aside, not refuted; no specific error is identified. If it gains expert uptake or journal acceptance it would become resolved. The two 2026 bounds are both human and progress-tier; the record does not say which bound is stronger, so rests_on picks Zhao's arbitrarily; ai_role is none either way.

outcome_prefix: Yuhang Zhao's arXiv preprint 2603.20890 (21 Mar 2026) improves the Choi-Wang lower bound on the first eigenvalue, leaving Yau's conjecture open; Zeng's 2025 claimed full proof is set aside as not credible.
